verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a locally run, cross-platform CLI and library set for converting and streaming media. It is not a hosted service that stores user data, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows FFmpeg offering any hosted storage or region selection that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
